product.title: Secluded Arches Sunset Experience Best Of Devils Garden Easy Hike

description.text: Experience a private desert sunset atop a secluded high cliff inside Arches National Park, away from massive park crowds. Beyond and high above Landscape Arch, the upper reaches of Devil's Garden require a short but steep climb up a sandstone fin (may challenge guests with fear of heights or limited mobility). Stops include Devils Garden, Landscape Arch, Devils Garden Sunset Overlook. Part of the hike takes place after sunset with limited natural light. Ideal for visitors basing in Moab who want a guided Arches National Park experience without coordinating timed entry, trailheads, or backcountry logistics on their own.
